label_notes: KNOWN GAP, spec-derived and documented, not fabricated: l1_policy.evaluate_l1_closure_eligibility() (Phase 3) is the function that OUGHT to emit a success-path code on verified closure, but grep-confirmed: Reason.CASE_CLOSE_VERIFIED is declared and classified POLICY_DECISION, yet NEVER actually appended to any reasons list anywhere in l1_policy.py or agent_orchestrator.py today (a successful closure currently returns an EMPTY reason_codes list, relying on eligible=True + already_closed alone). This case documents the intended success-path label per the audit's own closure-verification requirement; fixing the emission gap is a policy change, out of scope here. Also NOT reachable via run_policy_replay() at all — closure simulation isn't wired into batch replay (see replay_harness.py's own docstring, Phase 7A scope).
